title: WakePayload
description: Payload of a WorldEvent of type `wake`: the Body decided to wake the Mind (spec 5.3, Appendix C wake_on, plus reflex_danger, action_failed and limit_reached). Events only, no table. source_event_id derives from (life, tick, reason, intent), so a retry dedups.

tick.description: World age when the wake was decided.

intent_id.description: The intent the wake concerns, or null.
